body.name: Active-gradient persistence handle
body.construction: Starting from the exact kernel \(K_N(x,y)\), determine the active states of a difference-only minimax rule at each even \(n\), form their full-cell risk gradients, and seek a legal state-prior mixture or a common strictly decreasing full-count perturbation on every active state. Use the exact \(00\)-plus-\(11\) padding recurrence only after controlling the three induced allocation sizes and all newly feasible response-type states.
